args.subject: Re: Orchard IT OI-55968 / PO-48012
args.message: Hi Aisha, OI-55968 (USD 26,730.00, doc 5100006361) is blocked GR_MISSING, and there is no goods receipt at all in the ERP for PO-48012. If you can obtain the signed dock delivery note, please forward it to Receiving.
